_comment: Shared default identity for the chalette-dev skills. The skills read one key, operator, and say who they took you for. The owner's machine keeps a gitignored config/operator.local.json beside this file with operator set to m; signed-in GitHub accounts are checked first in web and phone chats, so the overlay is optional. Authority (who merges, who ships, who promotes) is not a field here: it is the GitHub role on the repo. This committed file must stay the contractor default (tests/test_operator_fences.py).
